artifacts.notes: Normalized transcription, not a facsimile or critical edition. Historical Latin wording is public domain in the United States; portal markup and translations have separate rights. Historical witness: Acta Apostolicae Sedis 1 (1909), pp. 637–653. Uncollated normalized web transcription; source wording and numbering retained apart from the explicitly recorded corrections and apparatus exclusions. Dating clause is 20 May 1909 (XIII kalendas iunias), unlike catalog index date 13 June. The historical cardinal/protonotary subscriptions on page 653 are retained. The official indexes give conflicting act dates. The reviewed act date is 1909-05-20, identified at https://www.vatican.va/archive/aas/documents/AAS-01-1909-ocr.pdf printed pp. 637–653; dating clause p. 653.
artifacts.rights_basis: Historical Latin wording identified in Acta Apostolicae Sedis 1 (1909), pp. 637–653, published by 1930. United States expired-term assessment under 17 U.S.C. 304/305; qualifying foreign restoration under 104A(a)(1)(B) only receives the remaining term. Under 103(b), this covers preexisting historical wording rather than modern creative additions. Vatican HTML, translations of later date, and scan/reprint wrappers have separate rights. See src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml.
